metadata.scenario: A customer calls to question an overcharge on their monthly utility bill, believing the amount to be incorrect. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Charles Thompson. I'm calling about an overcharge on my recent utility bill. Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Charles. Can you tell me more about the overcharge? Yes, I believe I was charged more than usual this month. It seems higher than what I usually pay. I understand. Have you checked if there were any additional services or changes that could have affected the bill? I did look, but I couldn't find anything. I think it might be an error. Can you help me resolve this? Absolutely, I can assist you with that. When did you receive the bill? I got it just a few days ago, so it should be the most recent billing cycle. Thank you for that information. Can I place you on hold while I look into our records related to this? Sure, I appreciate your help. [pause] Thanks for holding, Charles. I see here that your account is linked to your recent care services. Are you sure the charge is from utilities and not from our services? Oh, I see. I didn’t realize the billing was separate. Can you break it down for me? Certainly! Your recent charges include post-surgery wound care visits. How many visits were included in that? You had two visits last week, and each is priced at $85 to $110. That makes sense then, but I thought I was only scheduled for one visit last week. I can double-check that for you. Would you like me to send a detailed summary of your visits? Yes, please. A summary would be helpful. Great! I’ll email that to you. Is the email we have on file still your preferred address? Yes, that's correct. Perfect. And just to confirm, you'd also like to receive progress reports for the VA, right? Yes, I’d like those sent to them as well. Noted. I’ll ensure that’s included in our records. Thank you, Margaret. Is there anything else I should be aware of? Just a reminder that we offer additional services like companion care if you’re interested. I'll think about it. Thanks for the info! You’re welcome, Charles! I’ll follow up with that summary and the VA reports soon. Sounds good. I appreciate your help! Thank you for calling, have a great day! You too, bye!
